commands.name: baseline
commands.help: The baseline lockfile: what was approved. create | verify | update | diff.

commands.name: baseline create
commands.help:
Write agentguard.lock: file hashes, server launch commands, a hash per
tool definition, capabilities, risk tier and verdict of what is there now.

params.name: target
params.help: What to record (default: the current directory).

params.name: output
params.help: Lockfile path.

params.name: machine
params.help: Record every agent component installed on this machine.

params.name: approved_by
params.help: Who approved what the lock records.

params.name: review_by
params.help: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the approval should be looked at again.

params.name: accept_findings
params.help: Record the current findings as reviewed and accepted: later scans against this lock do not report them again.

commands.name: baseline diff
commands.help: What differs between two locks, or between a lock and what is there now.

params.name: old
params.help: A lockfile.

params.name: new
params.help: Another lockfile, or a target to compare the lock with (default: the current directory).

commands.name: baseline update
commands.help:
Record the current state as approved, and print what changed since the
previous lock. Entries that did not change keep their approval record.

commands.name: baseline verify
commands.help:
Re-scan what the lock records with the current rules and report what
changed: file content, versions, launch commands, tool definitions, tool
sets and capabilities (rug pulls and update drift).

params.name: baseline
params.help: Lockfile to compare against.

params.name: fail_on
params.help: Lowest severity of drift that fails the command.

commands.name: bench
commands.help: Run benchmark and regression suites and print a scorecard.

params.name: suite
params.help: corpus · evasion · incidents · perf · malskillbench · skilltrustbench · all (the suites that need no download).

params.name: corpus
params.help: Benchmark root containing manifest.yaml and corpus/.

params.name: data
params.help: Local copy of a public benchmark (never redistributed with Agent Guard).

params.name: split
params.help: Corpus suite: all | dev | heldout. skilltrustbench: subset (the fixed 556 cases) | full.

params.name: limit
params.help: Scan at most this many cases.

params.name: output
params.help: Write the scorecard JSON here.

params.name: perf
params.help: Corpus suite: also time 100 skills + 20 configs.

commands.name: detonate
commands.help:
Dynamic analysis only: run the target in a disposable container with no
route to the internet and no real credentials, and report what it did.
Fails if the sandbox is not available; it never falls back to the host.

params.name: target
params.help: What to detonate (any scan target that can be fetched to disk).

params.name: timeout
params.help: Seconds for the whole run (default 900).

params.name: adapter
params.help: claude-code, opencode or none (direct execution only).

params.name: keep_trace
params.help: Directory for the trace, the file diff and the network log.

commands.name: discover
commands.help: Alias of `inventory`.

commands.name: doctor
commands.help: Check the environment and report what each tier can use.

commands.name: explain
commands.help: Explain a rule or a finding: the risk, the cause and the fix.

params.name: ident
params.help: A rule id (AG-EXEC-001), an id/variant, an old alias, or a finding fingerprint (or its first characters).

params.name: report
params.help: JSON report to look a finding up in (default: the last scan).

params.name: json_out
params.help: JSON output.

commands.name: fix
commands.help:
Show or apply fixes. Every applied fix is followed by a re-scan of the
touched files; a fix that leaves its finding in place, adds a finding or
breaks parsing is rolled back. --emit-policy writes the least-privilege
policy (what each component needs, nothing more) for the agent to enforce.

params.name: target
params.help: A local path (your own files; a fix is never applied to a remote target).

params.name: finding
params.help: Fix only this finding (a fingerprint or its first characters).

params.name: rule
params.help: Fix only findings of this rule, alias or family.

params.name: safe_only
params.help: Only deterministic safe fixes; no model-drafted patch.

params.name: apply
params.help: Write the changes. Without it the command prints a unified diff.

params.name: network
params.help: NETWORK: look up the commit, version or hash a pinning fix needs.

params.name: llm
params.help: off · auto · always: let a configured model draft a patch where no deterministic fix exists. The draft is kept only after a clean re-scan. Default: auto.

params.name: emit_policy
params.help: Write the least-privilege policy (smallest allowed-tools, permission rules and sandbox profile per component) to this JSON file, for the agent to enforce.

params.name: json_out
params.help: JSON output.

commands.name: install
commands.help:
Scan, show the install receipt, then install.

The source is fetched to quarantine at a pinned identifier and scanned with
the installed context. The receipt lists every file that would be written
and every setting, hook, MCP entry or instruction file that would change.
On ALLOW (or REVIEW with --accept) the scanned bytes, not a fresh download,
are copied into place and agentguard.lock is updated.

params.name: source
params.help: What to install: any scan target (a GitHub URL, a package, an archive, a path).

params.name: agent
params.help: claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini, copilot or openclaw.

params.name: scope
params.help: project (this directory) or user (your home directory).

params.name: dest
params.help: Install root to use instead of the agent's default location.

params.name: accept
params.help: Install a REVIEW verdict (a BLOCK is never installed).

params.name: plan
params.help: Show the receipt and the verdict; write nothing.

params.name: approved_by
params.help: Recorded in agentguard.lock.

params.name: json_out
params.help: Machine-readable receipt (agent-safe: no scanned text).

commands.name: intel
commands.help: The local, signed indicator feed (see also `agentguard update`).

commands.name: intel status
commands.help: Show which indicator feed is active.

commands.name: intel update
commands.help: Install a newer signed indicator feed (signature and rollback checks enforced).

params.name: source
params.help: Path to feed.json (a feed.json.sig must sit next to it), or an https:// URL (NETWORK).

commands.name: inventory
commands.help:
List the agent components on this machine and in this project, with
their capabilities and risk tier; emit an AI-BOM with --format cyclonedx.

params.name: format
params.help: table, json or cyclonedx (the AI-BOM).

params.name: no_user
params.help: Skip home-directory locations.

params.name: project
params.help: Project root (default: current directory).

params.name: cards
params.help: Also print a trust card per component.

commands.name: lock
commands.help: Alias of `baseline create`.

commands.name: mcp
commands.help: MCP servers: inspect | probe.

commands.name: mcp inspect
commands.help:
List a server's tools, prompts and resources without calling them, hash
each definition for the baseline, and run the definition rules on them.

params.name: endpoint
params.help: mcp+https://… / https://… for a remote server, or mcp+stdio:<command> for a local one (started only inside the sandbox).

params.name: scan_too
params.help: Run the definition rules on what the server serves.

params.name: two_identities
params.help: List twice with different client identities to detect cloaked tool lists.

commands.name: mcp probe
commands.help:
Read-only posture check of a remote endpoint: TLS, the unauthenticated
response and its challenge, protected-resource and authorization-server
metadata, advertised grant types and PKCE. No tool is listed or called.

params.name: url
params.help: The remote endpoint (https://… or mcp+https://…).

commands.name: report
commands.help: Re-render a JSON report in another format (no rescan).

params.name: input
params.help: An Agent Guard JSON report.

commands.name: rules
commands.help: The rule pack: list | new | test | validate | import.

commands.name: rules explain
commands.help: Alias of `agentguard explain <rule id>`.

commands.name: rules export
commands.help: The rule pack with mappings and fixture examples, as JSON (used by the website).

commands.name: rules import
commands.help:
Import a community rule pack. Each imported rule becomes a variant of
the catalogue rule it corresponds to, in the advisory (hunt) lane.

params.name: source
params.help: A community pack: an Agent Threat Rules directory or file (YAML), or YARA files.

params.name: format
params.help: atr or yara (default: detected).

params.name: name
params.help: Name of the installed pack.

params.name: lane
params.help: Lane the imported rules run in. Community rules default to the advisory lane.

params.name: licence
params.help: Licence of the pack, recorded with it.

params.name: out
params.help: Write the pack here instead of installing it.

commands.name: rules list
commands.help:
List the rules of the catalogue with their status in this rule pack
(detectors from imported community packs are included).

params.name: family
params.help: One family, e.g. INJ.

params.name: status
params.help: planned, experimental, stable or deprecated.

params.name: format
params.help: table or json.

params.name: json_out
params.help: Same as --format json.

commands.name: rules new
commands.help: Scaffold a detection entry and a positive and a negative fixture.

params.name: rule_id
params.help: A catalogue rule id, e.g. AG-INJ-011.

params.name: variant
params.help: Add a narrower detector under a rule that already has one.

params.name: out
params.help: Pack directory to write into (rules/ and fixtures/ are created).

commands.name: rules test
commands.help: Run the positive and negative fixtures of the selected detectors.

params.name: selector
params.help: A rule id, id/variant, alias or family (default: every detector).

params.name: fixtures
params.help: Fixture root (default: the repository's fixtures/rules).

commands.name: rules validate
commands.help: Load the pack with the strict loader and check detectors, fixtures and mappings.

params.name: rule_pack
params.help: Extra pack directories to load with the built-in pack.

commands.name: scan
commands.help: Scan and report. Ends in one verdict: ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK.

params.name: targets
params.help: What to scan: a path, a GitHub URL (optionally @ref, or …/pull/N), pkg:npm/… or pkg:pypi/…, oci://…, an archive or bundle, mcp:<registry name>, mcp+https://… or mcp+stdio:<command>, or an OpenAPI / A2A descriptor. Several targets are scanned together. Default: the current directory.

params.name: machine
params.help: Scan every agent component installed on this machine.

params.name: profile
params.help: quick (deterministic static) · standard (adds the triage model and a gated adjudicator) · deep (adds dynamic analysis). Default: standard.

params.name: llm
params.help: off · auto (use a model when one is configured) · always. Default: auto.

params.name: dynamic
params.help: off · on: detonate the target in the sandbox (needs Docker). Default: off, on in the deep profile.

params.name: context
params.help: What the target is composed with: installed (the agent components on this machine) · none · a path. Default: installed.

params.name: policy
params.help: A preset (strict, balanced, permissive) or a policy file. Default: balanced.

params.name: format
params.help: terminal, json, sarif, md, html, junit, cyclonedx. Repeatable.

params.name: output
params.help: A file, or a directory when several formats are written. Default: stdout.

params.name: fail_on
params.help: block · review · severity:<level>. Default: block.

params.name: baseline
params.help: A lockfile of what was approved (default: agentguard.lock here, if present). A previous JSON report also works: only new findings are reported.

params.name: diff
params.help: <base>..<head>: scan the changed files in full, the rest as context, and report only new findings.

params.name: ref
params.help: Branch, tag or commit to scan (git and GitHub targets).

params.name: all_refs
params.help: Scan every branch and tag head.

params.name: history
params.help: <n|all>: also scan agent-facing files from the last n commits, including ones later removed.

params.name: submodules
params.help: on · off: read git submodules at their pinned commits. Default: on.

params.name: ecosystem
params.help: Comma list: claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini, copilot, openclaw. Default: all.

params.name: rules
params.help: Only these rules: ids, aliases, families (INJ) or prefixes (AG-INJ-). Comma list, repeatable.

params.name: exclude_rules
params.help: Rules to leave out (same selectors).

params.name: rule_pack
params.help: An additional rule pack directory. Repeatable.

params.name: offline
params.help: Forbid all network use; fail if a selected engine or target needs it.

params.name: max_llm_cost
params.help: Model budget for this scan, in USD.

params.name: max_llm_tokens
params.help: Model token budget for this scan.

params.name: estimate
params.help: Print the expected model cost and stop.

params.name: agent_safe_out
params.help: Never echo scanned text: rule ids, fixed wording, file and line, verdict and fix only.

params.name: jobs
params.help: Parallel fetches. Default: CPU count.

params.name: timeout
params.help: Seconds before the scan stops and reports what it did not reach. Default: 600.

params.name: config
params.help: Configuration file (default: .agentguard.yaml in the directory you run from; never one inside the target).

params.name: no_user
params.help: With --machine or --context installed: skip home-directory locations.

params.name: live_metadata
params.help: NETWORK: read tool lists from the remote MCP servers a config names (read-only; no tool is called).

params.name: auth_checks
params.help: NETWORK: check remote servers' TLS and OAuth posture.

params.name: osv
params.help: NETWORK: look up dependencies in OSV.

params.name: provenance
params.help: NETWORK: verify package provenance attestations.

params.name: registry
params.help: NETWORK: registry existence and package-age checks.

params.name: check_hijackable
params.help: NETWORK: check that referenced GitHub owners, packages and domains still exist. Uses $AGENTGUARD_GITHUB_TOKEN or $GITHUB_TOKEN for api.github.com only.

params.name: changed_since
params.help: Same as --diff <ref>..HEAD.

params.name: show_info
params.help: Show info-level findings in terminal output.

params.name: verbose
params.help: Show evidence, decoded content and standards mappings.

params.name: quiet
params.help: No progress notes on stderr.

params.name: timestamps
params.help: Include a generation timestamp and timings (output is then not reproducible).

commands.name: schema
commands.help: Print a JSON Schema for one of Agent Guard's data formats.

params.name: name
params.help: report | rule | lock | policy | config

commands.name: serve
commands.help:
Run as an MCP server or local HTTP API for agents. Output is agent-safe:
rule ids, fixed rule wording, file and line, verdict and fix summary; never
text from the target.

params.name: mcp
params.help: Speak MCP over stdio (tools: agentguard_scan, agentguard_check_install, agentguard_explain, agentguard_inventory).

params.name: http
params.help: Serve the local HTTP API.

params.name: host
params.help: HTTP bind address (loopback only unless you change it).

params.name: reports
params.help: Where full reports for the human are written.

commands.name: update
commands.help:
Refresh the rule pack and the intelligence bundle. A bundle is used only
after its signature verifies against a trusted release key; a bundle older
than the installed one is refused.

params.name: source
params.help: A local update bundle (air-gapped use), or an https:// URL. Default: the configured source.

params.name: check
params.help: Verify the bundle and show what it holds; install nothing.

commands.name: verify
commands.help: Alias of `baseline verify`.
